title: UltraHomes
description: Modern homes system with GUI, home shop, Essentials migration, Vault support and powerful admin tools.
body:
# UltraHomes

A modern homes system for Paper and Spigot servers.

UltraHomes was built as a complete replacement for traditional home plugins and provides a clean GUI experience, home slot upgrades, Essentials migration and powerful administration tools.

---

## Features

- Modern homes GUI
- Home editing interface
- Home rename system
- Home deletion protection
- Home shop
- Purchase additional home slots
- Vault integration
- EssentialsX home migration
- Dimension filtering
- Admin management tools
- bStats integration
- Local storage
- No database required

---

## Home Shop

Players start with a configurable amount of home slots.

Additional slots can be purchased directly through the GUI using Vault-supported economy plugins.

---

## Essentials Migration

UltraHomes can import existing EssentialsX homes.

Supported:

- Java players
- Floodgate / Bedrock players
- Offline UUID setups
- Online UUID setups

---

## Admin Features

- View player homes
- Teleport to player homes
- Add additional slots
- Set slot amounts
- Import Essentials homes

---

## Commands

### Player Commands

```text
/home
/homes
/sethome <name>
/delhome <name>
```

### Admin Commands

```text
/homeadmin importessentials
/homeadmin gui <player>
/homeadmin tp <player> <home>
/homeadmin addslots <player> <amount>
/homeadmin setslots <player> <amount>
```

---

## Dependencies

Optional:

- Vault

Migration only:

- EssentialsX

---

## Support

Discord:

https://discord.die-sofaecke.de

Suggestions, bug reports and feedback are welcome.

---

## Statistics

UltraHomes uses bStats to collect anonymous usage statistics.
